mainHeading: Regulation of the Alumni Association of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi.
article1_1: The Alumni Association of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi (hereinafter referred to as the Association) is a voluntary public organization established without forming a legal entity, in order to carry out joint activities determined by common interests.
article1_2: The Association conducts its activities based on the principles of equality of its members, self-governance, voluntariness, openness, and democracy.
article1_3: The main directions of the Association's activities are adopted at the General Meeting of TUIT graduates (hereinafter referred to as the General Meeting) and are enshrined in this Regulation.
article1_4: The official full name of the Association: “Alumni Association of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi.”
chapter2Title: CHAPTER 2. GOALS AND OBJECTIVES OF THE ASSOCIATION
goalTitle: 2.1. The main goals of the Association are as follows:
goal1: To strengthen corporate spirit among TUIT students and graduates of all generations, to promote solidarity, self-awareness, and social activity;
goal2: To preserve and strengthen university traditions, and to increase the international prestige of TUIT;
goal3: To encourage graduates to maintain relations with the university and the alumni community;
goal4: To increase the efficiency of using the intellectual potential of TUIT graduates and the university's opportunities in training and retraining specialists demanded by the labor market.
goal5: To unite the efforts of graduates capable of contributing to the development of the university.
taskTitle: 2.2. To achieve its goals, the Association carries out the following tasks:
task1: Creates an information and communication environment to ensure permanent contact between graduates and the university, and among themselves;
task2: Creates conditions for the implementation of scientific and technical ideas directly related to members of the Association;
task3: Contributes to the expansion of social, pedagogical, scientific, and business relations between TUIT, its graduates, and members of the Association;
task4: Represents the university with dignity in the professional community;
task5: Enhances the prestige of TUIT as a recognized leader in the field of communications and telecommunications, which trains in-demand specialists and guarantees high-quality education;
task6: Provides assistance to Association members in professional retraining and advanced training at TUIT, in organizations and research institutions in Uzbekistan and abroad; contributes to the development of effective forms and technologies for organizing the educational process and scientific research;
task7: Assists TUIT in career guidance for young people, recruitment, distribution, and employment of graduates;
task8: Promotes the development of TUIT’s social partnership, coordination, and implementation of the interests of employers, state and local authorities, educational institutions, and public organizations;
task9: Contributes to the development of additional professional education at TUIT;
task10: Creates and/or develops new collective forms of information, legal, and advertising services for the Association;
task11: Creates conditions for the implementation of scientific and technical ideas directly related to members of the Association;
task12: Helps organize meetings with TUIT graduates;
task13: Assists in establishing educational, scientific, and business relations between TUIT and enterprises in Uzbekistan and foreign countries;
task14: Recommends members of the Association for election to the TUIT Board of Trustees;
task15: Cooperates with the TUIT Board of Trustees in solving common tasks to support the activities and development of the university.
chapter3Title: CHAPTER 3. MEMBERS OF THE ASSOCIATION, THEIR RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS
article3_1: Any graduate of TUIT of any year may become a member of the Association.
article3_2: Members of the Association may include physical and legal persons – public associations participating in its activities and in the work of the TUIT Alumni Association. The interest in jointly solving the Association’s tasks and the desire to join it is formalized by an individual application of the graduate. Members of the Association – physical and legal persons – public associations have equal rights and obligations.
article3_3Title: 3.3. Members of the Association have the right to:
article3_3_1: One vote at all General Meetings, elections, and working meetings of the TUIT Alumni Association; decisions are made by voting of the Association members;
article3_3_2: Participate in all activities and events of the Association;
article3_3_3: Receive information and other materials of the Association;
article3_3_4: Use the materials prepared by the Association in their activities;
article3_4Title: 3.4. Members of the Association are obliged to:
article3_4_1: Carry the title of TUIT graduate honestly and with dignity;
article3_4_2: Actively contribute to the achievement of the Association's goals and objectives;
article3_4_3: Participate in events held by decision of the General Meeting and the Association Council;
article3_4_5: Inform about changes in home and work address, phone numbers;
article3_4_6: Provide advice and assistance in the implementation of the Association’s activities;
article3_4_7: Promote the dissemination of activity results;
article3_4_8: Fulfill obligations arising from the Regulation.
article3_5: The issue of admission to membership and withdrawal is resolved on the basis of a written application.
article3_6: Membership may be terminated by the decision of the Association Council if activities contradict the Regulation.
chapter4Title: CHAPTER 4. STRUCTURE AND MANAGEMENT OF THE ASSOCIATION
chapter4.1: The governing bodies of the TUIT Alumni Association: the General Meeting of the TUIT Alumni Association, the President of the TUIT Alumni Association (hereinafter – the President), and the Council of the TUIT Alumni Association (hereinafter – the Association Council).
chapter4.2: The highest governing body of the Association is the General Meeting of graduates.
chapter4.3: During the period between General Meetings, the governing body of the Association is the Association Council.
chapter4.4: Members of the Association Council are elected for a term of three years. Their powers may be terminated early by the decision of the Association Council.
chapter4.5: The Association Council independently determines its structure and working regulations.
chapter4.6: The Association Council elects from among its members the Vice-President(s) and the Executive Director of the Association.
chapter4.7: The Presidium of the Alumni Association includes: the President, Vice-Presidents, and the Executive Director.
chapter4.8: The General Meeting of TUIT graduates is held at least once a year. The time and place of the General Meeting, as well as its agenda, are determined by the Association Council.
chapter4.9Title: The Association Council performs the following functions:
chapter4.9.list2: Convenes the General Meeting of the Alumni Association;
chapter4.9.list3: Presents an annual report on the Association’s activities to the General Meeting;
chapter4.9.list4: Regularly informs about its work and the activities of the Association through mass media;
chapter4.9.list5: Organizes and conducts conferences, meetings, and gatherings on topics of the Association;
chapter4.9.list6: Awards members of the Association for outstanding achievements in implementing the plans and objectives of the Association; – resolves other issues in accordance with the approved work plan.
chapter4.10Title: The President of the Association is elected by the General Assembly for a term of five years. The President performs the following functions:
chapter4.10.list1: Provides general leadership of the Association’s activities;
chapter4.10.list2: Represents the interests of the Association in state and public organizations;
chapter4.10.list3: Leads and organizes the work of the Association Council;
chapter4.10.list4: Convenes meetings of the Association Council;
chapter4.10.list5: Chairs the General Meeting of the TUIT Alumni Association;
chapter4.11: In the absence of the President, his/her duties are performed by the Vice-President (one of the Vice-Presidents).
chapter4.12: The Vice-President is elected by the TUIT Alumni Association Council for a term of three years. The Association Council defines the scope of the Vice-President’s duties in accordance with the activities of the Association.
chapter5.1: Disputes and disagreements related to the implementation of this Regulation are resolved peacefully or in the manner prescribed by the court.
chapter5.2: The reorganization and liquidation of the Association shall be carried out by the University Council in the manner prescribed by law.
chapter5.3: Persons found guilty of violating the requirements of this Regulation shall be held liable in accordance with the law.
